title: Text API gets another model and smoother message handling
summary:
A small, useful day for text.pollinations.ai: a new Mistral model, better compatibility, and two more projects growing in public.

Mistral Small 24B from Scaleway joined text.pollinations.ai, while system messages are now translated into user messages for models that do not support them. One endpoint, more model quirks quietly handled.

All text.pollinations.ai requests now register with the text feed, alongside Google service-account authentication work for the service.

PromptPix, an Android app, was added to the project list. MiReXa AI also arrived under its new name with audio generation in the mix.
